summary: Use unchanged accepted source-pixel adapter with all long/short stations in one explicit request. Existing receipt contains every required raw channel and crop/source control. No new CV stage or measurement wrapper is needed; an optional pure receipt projection may reduce manual bookkeeping after separate admission.
intent: Compare one caller-declared long longitudinal window with ordered caller-declared short windows without turning averaged fits, nulls, brightness, or adjacent fit similarity into path identity or acceptance.

receiptFlow: Freeze exact original source identity, ROI, complete training, candidate widths, known boxes, edge settings, all poses/windows and explicit declared groups before measurement.
Make one unchanged adapter call. Unsupported ROI remains whole-request UNKNOWN with zero recipe calls; do not enlarge ROI or drop training without a separately frozen packet.
Supported request executes crop recipe then original-source recipe exactly once each, with all long/short/control stations included. Retain both outputs and full equivalence differences.
Project every station/candidate row and complete profile/counts from both branches by declared ID, never by fit score, nearest fit, successful station subset, or learner width.
Report only predeclared algebraic differences, per-row sampling eligibility and exact fit/null states. Figure must be receipt-driven and retain nulls/disagreements.

criticalSemantics.profile: JS profileAt averages arange(t0,t1,1) along supplied pose. It does not establish paired edges at every longitudinal location.
criticalSemantics.minimum: edgePairOf requires ok[j] >= max(8,0.2*nT) at at least 60% of 241 offsets before peak search. nT<8 necessarily fails this unchanged guard even with every sample visible.
criticalSemantics.null: A null fit is unavailable evidence, not a missing edge, zero offset, discontinuity, or failure of path identity. nT>=8 is necessary, not sufficient. Keep sampling-guard failure distinct from search-stage null when receipt permits the distinction.
criticalSemantics.sensor: Dev72 observeFourLaneCrossSection uses station pose and width, not t0/t1. At identical pose/width it repeats across changed windows. Different short-window midpoint poses provide different raw sensor observations; the projection must never imply otherwise.
criticalSemantics.association: Station order is explicit caller declaration. Candidate width is exact widthArgPx, not calibrated width. Similar l/r/c/w across adjacent windows is raw fit-coordinate association only and does not prove that fitted edges are the same physical edges.
criticalSemantics.crop: Exact pixel crop does not guarantee numerical fit invariance. Keep every existing >1e-9 source/crop difference and UNKNOWN; never average, replace, choose a winning branch or relax tolerance.

cost.reconExecution: No measurement or tests executed in this design phase; only source/docs/hash/Git read-only checks.
cost.stationCount: S = sum over all declared groups of (1 long + K short) plus explicitly declared controls, avoiding duplicate station declarations only before freeze
cost.dominantWork: Full/crop raster copying/luminance planes plus 241*sum(nT) profile samples in each branch and unchanged learner/sensor/fit work. Overlapping long/short windows pay repeated profiling; no acceleration claim.
cost.optionalProjection: Zero recipe/CV calls; O(S*B + S*241 + retained equivalence-difference count) output/projection work; exact serialized receipt already retained rather than duplicating image bytes.
cost.resourceBoundary: Finite accepted input validation is not a practical size cap. Root must admit the concrete frozen S/B/window lengths and expected full/crop raster cost before a run; no arbitrary new cap invented here.

testPlan: Existing unchanged adapter 8 tests, composition 10 tests, and staging 2 tests are prior evidence only until rerun under a separately admitted implementation/verification packet.
If no helper is admitted, independently replay each frozen actual caller once and require exact request/source identities, complete paired receipt and all row identities/counts.

If helper is admitted, TDD pure fixtures first: default-OFF; malformed/missing IDs; duplicate groups; exact candidate width matching; all fit/null combinations; preserved UNKNOWN; immutable inputs; nonfinite serialization; no calls to adapter/composition.
Synthetic receipt controls cover nT 1/7/8/9, fully visible and masked counts, legacy max(8,0.2*nT)/60% guard without interpreting null as absence.
Projection must retain every profile/count/raw learner/channel/fit/null, original receipt digest and every crop/source disagreement, including known rotated-fit and nearest-round seams.

Fixed algebra tests compare adjacent declared IDs and each short to its declared long at each exact width separately per branch; changing order changes only declared pairs, never resorts by fitted values.
Different-heading or nonfinite geometry must keep raw rows and mark cross-window common-normal deltas unavailable, rather than infer transformed sameness; no threshold or score verdict.
Independent reviewer receives candidate source freeze before actual course protocol release; no claim of scientific blindness for already exposed historical material.
